label: 1310/1490nm GPON WDM coupler, SC/APC
description: Three-port filter WDM coupler for GPON ODN work: 1310 nm upstream passes to the reflection/upstream port while 1490 nm downstream (and 1550 nm RF overlay) crosses to the PON port, letting an OTDR or upstream receiver be inserted on a live branch. Thin-film filter, SC/APC on all three ports, insertion loss <=0.7 dB, channel isolation >30 dB, return loss >=55 dB, passive.
